name: Hari Libur Nasional & Cuti Bersama Indonesia (1946–2030, multibahasa)
title: Hari Libur Nasional & Cuti Bersama Indonesia (1946–2030, multibahasa)
description: Indonesian national public holidays (Hari Libur Nasional) and government joint-leave days (Cuti Bersama) for 1946–2030, computed algorithmically by vacanza/holidays under the MIT license. Two vacanza categories: PUBLIC (Hari Libur Nasional — Tahun Baru Masehi, Tahun Baru Imlek, Hari Suci Nyepi, Wafat Yesus Kristus, Hari Buruh Internasional, Kenaikan Yesus Kristus, Hari Lahir Pancasila, Hari Raya Idul Fitri, Hari Raya Waisak, Hari Raya Idul Adha, Tahun Baru Islam, Hari Kemerdekaan Indonesia, Maulid Nabi Muhammad, Isra Mikraj Nabi Muhammad, Hari Raya Natal, Hari Pemilihan Umum, etc.) and GOVERNMENT (Cuti Bersama — administrative joint-leave days surrounding the main holidays). Multilingual names in id/en_US/th/uk per Indonesia.supported_languages. Federal scope (no subdivisions). Schema matches the canonical-pin completos pattern established for KO (pass 287), DE/FR/NL (passes 284-286), and the prior 19-locale completos chain.

meta.description: Indonesian national public holidays (Hari Libur Nasional) and government joint-leave days (Cuti Bersama) for 1946–2030, computed algorithmically by vacanza/holidays under the MIT license. Two vacanza categories: PUBLIC (Hari Libur Nasional — Tahun Baru Masehi, Tahun Baru Imlek, Hari Suci Nyepi, Wafat Yesus Kristus, Hari Buruh Internasional, Kenaikan Yesus Kristus, Hari Lahir Pancasila, Hari Raya Idul Fitri, Hari Raya Waisak, Hari Raya Idul Adha, Tahun Baru Islam, Hari Kemerdekaan Indonesia, Maulid Nabi Muhammad, Isra Mikraj Nabi Muhammad, Hari Raya Natal, Hari Pemilihan Umum, etc.) and GOVERNMENT (Cuti Bersama — administrative joint-leave days surrounding the main holidays). Multilingual names in id/en_US/th/uk per Indonesia.supported_languages. Federal scope (no subdivisions). Schema matches the canonical-pin completos pattern established for KO (pass 287), DE/FR/NL (passes 284-286), and the prior 19-locale completos chain. Berisi 1231 rekaman. Unduh dalam format Excel, CSV, PDF.
